title: Part Three: 1967, Occupation and the First Settlements

sections.brief: June 1967 in the West Bank: the second exodus, the Latrun villages, Resolution 242 and its two readings. Figures: stats.
East Jerusalem: the June 1967 laws, the 70 km² boundary, the Mughrabi Quarter, the Security Council's response. Figure: compare.
The legal warning and the first settlements: the Meron opinion, Kfar Etzion, the Allon Plan, Hebron and Kiryat Arba; Israel's legal position; settler numbers to 1977. Figures: timeline; stats.
